items.text: You get a text: "Kestrel Bank: your account is blocked. Reply with the 6-digit code we just sent to unblock it."

options.label: Reply with the code so the account is unblocked
Ignore the text and call the number on my card

items.text: A voice note from a new number sounds like your daughter: "Mum, send ₦80,000 now, I'm in trouble. I'll explain later."

options.label: Call her on her usual number or ask our family code word
Send the money first, she sounds scared

items.text: A message says your parcel is held and asks you to pay a ₦1,500 delivery fee through a link.

options.label: Pay the small fee through the link
Check with the seller or courier through a contact I already have

items.text: At your POS point, a customer shows you a transfer alert on his phone and asks for ₦25,000 cash right away.

options.label: Wait until my own banking app shows the money
Give the cash, the alert looks real

items.text: A caller says he is from a law-enforcement agency. He says you will be arrested today unless you pay a ₦50,000 fine by transfer.

options.label: Pay the fine to avoid arrest
Hang up and contact the agency's official office myself

items.text: A caller says your BVN will be deactivated in 30 minutes unless you confirm your details and a code sent to you.

options.label: Hang up and call my bank on the number on my card
Confirm my details and the code quickly

items.text: A message from a new number says: "It's your brother. Lost my phone. Please send ₦20,000 airtime or cash urgently."

options.label: Send it, he needs help now
Call my brother's usual number first

items.text: A message says you won a ₦500,000 prize in a promo. To receive it, you must first pay a ₦5,000 processing fee.

options.label: Do not pay. Check the promo through an official channel I find myself
Pay the fee to collect the prize

items.text: Someone says they sent ₦30,000 to your account by mistake and asks you to send it back today.

options.label: Send it back right away to be fair
Check my own banking app and ask my bank before sending anything

items.text: A "bank agent" calls and says your money is at risk. He asks you to move it to a "safe account" he will give you.

options.label: Hang up and call my bank on a number I already have
Move the money to the safe account
